caption: The drawing depicts a single brown cowboy boot positioned slightly facing to the left. The boot appears worn, with creased leather and a slouched upper section. There are two pull straps at the top of the boot, which is mid-calf in height. The sole and heel show some signs of use, with the toe area slightly lifted and the bottom edges darker, possibly indicating wear. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or visual elements present. The artist’s signature, "LeRoy Griffith," is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Child's Boot
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
